Prompts

```
['run a single video QA request on a video file using LLaVA-Video model with specified number of frames', 'run batch video QA processing on a directory of videos, splitting into chunks and saving results to CSV files', 'find all video files (mp4, avi, mov) in a given directory or return a single video file path', 'split a list of video file paths into a specified number of chunks for distributed processing', 'save video QA batch results to CSV files with video name and answer columns']
```

```
{'run_video_qa_single': 'run a single video QA request on a video file using LLaVA-Video model with specified number of frames', 'run_video_qa_batch': 'run batch video QA processing on a directory of videos, splitting into chunks and saving results to CSV files', 'find_video_files': 'find all video files (mp4, avi, mov) in a given directory or return a single video file path', 'split_video_list_into_chunks': 'split a list of video file paths into a specified number of chunks for distributed processing', 'save_video_qa_results': 'save video QA batch results to CSV files with video name and answer columns'}
```
